notes: All zip advisories affect extract/extract_stream convenience APIs. Production workspace import uses bounded reads, rejects symlink ZIP entries, validates manifest paths, creates ordinary files with create_new, and never restores archive Unix permissions. Those vulnerable methods are unused in application source.
Tokio AsyncFd constructors are not used by application source; transitive usage is not fully audited.
Vendored glib patch RUSTSEC-2024-0429 is already documented and not reported in this cargo audit.
No Cargo manifests or locks were changed. Remaining three Cargo audits were intentionally not run after exact four npm advisories were identified.
scope: Auxiliary Rust triage only: the Cargo findings are separate from the four reported npm fast-uri advisories and were not changed by this fix.
